newsitem.title: DUBAI: One killed, several missing in Omani ship capsize.
newsitem.headline: One killed, several missing in Omani ship capsize.

text.p: One man was killed and at least nine were missing after an Omani cargo ship capsized in the Arabian Sea, regional news agencies said.
The ship, carrying a 13-member crew, capsized on Thursday near the island of Masirah east of Oman because of bad weather, they reported late on Friday.
Three men were rescued and taken to hospital. One body was recovered and rescue teams were searching for any other survivors or bodies.
The agencies gave no further details and Omani officials were not immediately available for comment.
